mapper.sql: select d.device_id, d.customer_org_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, m.brand_id, b.brand_name, d.model_id, m.model_code, m.model_name, d.device_name, d.serial_number, d.install_location, d.purchase_date, d.install_date, d.warranty_end_date, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark from oc_device d inner join oc_customer_org c on c.customer_org_id = d.customer_org_id inner join oc_product_model m on m.model_id = d.model_id inner join oc_brand b on b.brand_id = m.brand_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from oc_device where customer_org_id = #{customerOrgId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from oc_device where model_id = #{modelId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into oc_device ( customer_org_id, model_id, device_name, serial_number, install_location, purchase_date, install_date, warranty_end_date, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{customerOrgId}, #{modelId}, #{deviceName}, #{serialNumber}, #{installLocation}, #{purchaseDate}, #{installDate}, #{warrantyEndDate}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update oc_device set customer_org_id = #{customerOrgId}, model_id = #{modelId}, device_name = #{deviceName}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, install_location = #{installLocation}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, install_date = #{installDate}, warranty_end_date = #{warrantyEndDate}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where device_id = #{deviceId} and del_flag = '0'
